HEADER: Init +4; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +3
DEFENSE: AC 21, touch 13; flat-footed 17 (+4 dex, +8 natural, -1 size)
OFFENSE: Speed 40 ft., Climb 40 ft., Swim 40 ft.
Melee +1 Scimitars +12/+12/+7/+7/+2 (1d6+6/15-20 plus 1 wisdom drain on first hit each round), or Touch +14 (1d4 Wisdom drain)
3rd (DC 18) - Cura, Cure III, Dispel, Haste, Major Image, Sleepga
STATISTICS: Str 20, Dex 19, Con 17, Int 16, Wis 16, Cha 21
Base Atk +10; CMB +16; CMD 29 (can't be tripped)
Feats Double Slice, Improved Critical (scimitar), Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (scimitar)

Skills Acrobatics +8 (+12 jump), Bluff +21, Climb +13, Diplomacy +11, Disguise +11, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (any one) +15, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Spellcraft +15, Swim +13, Use Magic Device +21; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Bluff, +4 Use Magic Device
SQ Change Shape (fixed Medium humanoid form, alter self), Undersized Weapons
Gear 2 +1 Scimitars, 5th-lvl illusionist or white mage scroll
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Although a lamia matriarch is Large, its upper torso is the same size as that of a Medium humanoid. As a result, lamia matriarchs wield weapons as if they were one size category smaller than their actual size (Medium for most lamias).

A lamia matriarch blows a kiss towards her target as pink hearts are being thrown from her lips towards him. The target must make a Will save (DC 19) or be affected as if by a Charm spell for a duration of 1 minute. The charm effect on this ability is harder to overcome unlike other charm spells and has its DC increase by 1. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

A lamia matriarch drains 1d4 points of Wisdom each time it hits with its melee touch attack. (Unlike with other kinds of ability drain attacks, a lamia matriarch does not heal any damage when it uses its Wisdom drain.) Lamia matriarchs try to use this power early in an encounter to make foes more susceptible to charm.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
